rows.grounds: introductory particle marking transition to the next topic
adverb indicating consequence from the preceding description
first-person singular active future of saṃ-pra-vac, announcing forthcoming instruction
genitive singular of śaktikūṭa, the third mantra division
accusative singular neuter, object of saṃpravakṣyāmi

items.question: What practice or means for the śaktikūṭa division will now be declared?
premises: The speaker transitions to a new topic.
The declared item is its sādhana.
items.inference: The verse announces that the means of the śaktikūṭa mantra division will now be taught.
uncertainties: ātaḥ may mean 'from this' rather than 'thus'.
The gender and number of śaktikūṭa are not explicit on the surface.
items.plain_english: Now, thus, I will declare the means of the śaktikūṭa.
